skip_tests.reason: Measures CTE restrictions using planner dependencies deliberately discarded by serialization
Extension optimizer pass breaks logical plan serialization
Deserialized plans lose the join filters that late materialization pushes into its scan, see https://github.com/duckdblabs/bot-issue-tracker/issues/715
Plan serialization discards cardinality estimates, so the probe consumer is kept materialized by cost and no cycle demotion occurs.
